conclusions.text: The exact 279 county IDs, county role, state crosswalk, and parent assignment are reproducible against the retained source and the two Census county vintages.
The two area labels and state memberships match Census division groupings; the 1,422-member Atlas region is a custom grouping and its interior remains unapproved.
Five coastal county geometry signals, three invalid Census TIGER references, and the repository catalog/raw-source hash discrepancy remain unresolved and require bounded follow-up.
The available statistical/cartographic references do not establish the legal correctness or complete shoreline/island coverage of the Atlas county boundaries.

methods.description: Match the exact issue roster to national GeoBoundaries shapeIDs, Census 2018/2025 county GEOIDs, source vintage/role, and current state parent IDs.

methods.area_method: Planar equal-area intersection / union; helper's WGS84 transform/area positive and negative controls also run
methods.crs: EPSG:4326 input to EPSG:6933 equal-area projection
methods.description: Compare unmodified source geometries using intersection-over-union after EPSG:6933 equal-area transformation; threshold is triage only. Invalid Census rings are retained and repaired only in-memory for comparison.
methods.distance_method: Not measured; no distances or adjacency are inferred

methods.description: Generate canonical result JSON and summaries in a fresh output directory; verify exact roster, no overwrite, and byte-identical repeated runs.
methods.units: 279 scoped county records and seven IoU comparisons per county
